ex99.lead: JPMorgan Chase & Co. 270 Park Avenue, NY 10017-2014 NYSE symbol: JPM www.jpmorganchase.com News release: IMMEDIATE JPMorganChase announces Bregje de Best will succeed Jeremy Barnum as Chief Financial Officer following first-quarter 2027 financial reporting. Barnum to become a Vice Chairman at that time. New York, November 17, 2026 – JPMorganChase announced today that Bregje de Best, Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the Commercial & Investment Bank (CIB), will succeed Jeremy Barnum as CFO of the company following its first-quarter 2027 financial reporting. At that time, de Best will join the firmwide Operating Committee (OC), and Barnum will become a Vice Chairman of the company. Barnum informed the company of his intention to conclude his tenure as CFO after six years in the role and to support the transition to the next generation of talent. He and de Best will work closely between now
